name: Kelime Oyunu
description: Kelime Oyunu (Word Game) is a Turkish game show that was awarded by the Turkish Language Association for "the correct use of Turkish and its contributions to Turkish" and broadcasted every weekday on Kanal 1, Bloomberg HT, Show TV, FOX and continues to be broadcast on teve2.
